item.title: Barry fires Everton to dramatic win at Newcastle
item.description: Thierno Barry came off the bench to fire Everton to Premier League victory at Newcastle for the second successive season in a dramatic conclusion to a madcap encounter.

item.title: Liverpool boost UCL hopes with 5-2 West Ham win
item.description: Liverpool boosted their hopes of Champions League qualification after beating West Ham United 5-2 at Anfield on Saturday.

item.title: Semenyo scores only goal as City cut Arsenal lead
item.description: Antoine Semenyo netted the only goal of the game as Manchester City beat Leeds United 1-0 on Saturday to cut Arsenal's Premier League lead to two points.
